title: profile [session] model/effort is never applied
what: relay sync (and install) write the active profile's [session] model and effort into the user settings (~/.claude/settings.json keys model and effortLevel), merging like merge_user_settings does; relay doctor reports a mismatch.
why: 24 Oct, owner asked how to record the front's effort in relay. profiles/active.toml has [session] model = "opus", effort = "high" and calls itself "the setup every session runs", but only lib/relay_bench.py reads [session]; relay sync never writes them, and ~/.claude/settings.json holds effortLevel "high" set by hand. A change to [session] (an adopted candidate, say) silently does nothing for real sessions.
failing_case: Set [session] effort = "medium" in profiles/active.toml and run `relay sync`: ~/.claude/settings.json still says effortLevel "high".
pass_cases: After `relay sync` the settings carry the profile's model and effortLevel, other keys untouched; `relay sync --dry` names the change; a second sync is unchanged.
